profile_text.body:
Berkshire Grey describes itself as a provider of AI-powered robotic automation solutions for warehouse, ecommerce, retail, and 3PL logistics operations. The company says its physical AI warehouse automation solutions accelerate fulfillment, reduce operating costs, and scale with a business. Its site highlights Stride, a shuttle sorting system that uses autonomous shuttles and intelligent routing to automate sorting across a wide range of item types with reliable, scalable throughput.

Berkshire Grey is a for-profit startup founded in 2013 and headquartered in Bedford, Massachusetts, United States. The available facts record 191 Massachusetts law exposure entries for the company and list no litigation cases.
